objective: Design, independently review, implement, verify, merge, and locally deploy the Drumline Agent Exchange without allowing discussion to become authority or durable truth implicitly.
constraints: The dirty human checkout at C:/AI/baton/Batoncadence is read-only and is never staged, cleaned, reset, stashed, committed, or used as release evidence.
All repository work uses isolated worktrees based on freshly fetched origin/main; reviewers inspect the exact commit named in the evidence.

Agent Exchange discussion is non-authoritative, never automatically injected into worker prompts, never an effect authorization, and reaches agent_context only through an authenticated audited sanitized tenant-scoped idempotent promotion.
Existing mco and MCO_* names, ~/.mco paths, bearer-token format, AES-256-GCM vault AAD, UUID5 recipes, API, database, CLI, and console compatibility remain intact.
R01 and R02 rejection, missing required security evidence, or a failed CI or CodeQL check blocks merge; there is no manual merge-around.
No cloud or AWS work is authorized. Deployment is limited to the local BitCadence gateway after merge and with a proven rollback target.
Jev is advisory only; deterministic policy controls reviewer independence, authority, merge, deployment, and spend.
Every phase failure exhausts its bounded attempts and escalates to the mission owner with evidence; it never silently releases a dependent phase.

tasks.title: Author the Drumline Agent Exchange design and governed Score
tasks.instructions: ALLOWED PATHS: docs/DRUMLINE-AGENT-EXCHANGE-DESIGN.md, examples/scores/drumline-agent-exchange.score.json, tests/test_drumline_agent_exchange_score.py. Work only in the isolated D01 worktree. Reconcile origin/main, queue, live gateway executable/CWD evidence, GitHub, current docs, and the dirty prototype read-only. Author the smallest coherent design, validate the Score, run focused tests including the negative R01 gate proof, commit only the allowed paths, and return the exact commit, base SHA, test receipt, drift report, Jev receipt, and no-secret receipt. One failed attempt is terminal and escalates to the mission owner; do not implement B01, open a PR, merge, deploy, or perform cloud work.

tasks.title: Open the PR, enforce exact-head CI gates, and merge safely
tasks.instructions: ALLOWED PATHS: GitHub PR metadata and the already reviewed feat/drumline-agent-exchange commit only; no source edits, force-push, branch rewrite, generated-file change, or merge-around. Start only from an accepted R02 receipt bound to the exact head. Open the feature PR, request an independent review, and require CI, focused/full relevant tests, PostgreSQL acceptance when selected by the workflow, security tests, secret scan, and CodeQL to pass on that same head. Reconcile origin/main before merge. Merge only the reviewed head, record PR URL/number, review receipt, check names/conclusions/SHAs, merge SHA, and prior rollback SHA. A failure or stale head is terminal and blocks D02; fixes require a new B01/R02 cycle and mission-owner escalation.
